map.术后恢复时间表生成器，选择医美项目类型生成红斑、肿胀、结痂恢复时间与护理建议，辅: Generates a recovery timeline for a chosen aesthetic procedure, giving expected redness, swelling and scab times with care advice, supporting informed consent discussions.
map.陪护安排：家属按时间表了解何时需陪同、何时可自理。: Caregiver planning: families see from the timeline when company is needed and when the patient can manage alone.
map.护肤重启：提示何时可从修护期转回常规护肤。: Skincare resumption: shows when it is safe to return from the repair phase to normal skincare.
map.风险识别：某阶段异常延长即预警。: Risk flagging: an abnormally long stage becomes a warning sign.
map.：输入：水光针 → 针眼 6–12h 闭合、红肿 1–2 天、可正常护肤 2–3: Input: skin booster injection, so the needle punctures close in 6-12 hours, redness and swelling last 1-2 days, normal skincare resumes in 2-3 days and results stabilise in a week; no makeup within 24 hours.
map.所有人恢复一样吗？: Does everyone recover at the same rate?
map.不一样。代谢、护理、能量不同，区间仅供参考。: No. Metabolism, aftercare and energy levels differ, so treat the ranges as guidance only.
map.不建议。创口未闭易感染，按医嘱时间。: Not recommended. An unhealed wound is prone to infection; follow the time your clinician gives.
map.本表作医疗依据吗？: Is this table a medical basis?
map.不作。术后以医师指导为最终依据。: No. After a procedure the clinician's instructions are the final authority.
